gbm_population_evidence.quote: in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma or Anaplastic Astrocytoma
Patients with unresectable or resectable HGG (AA or GBM) will be enrolled.

candidate_evidence.quote: Approximately 6 weeks after surgery, patients will start drug therapy with a 7-day oral regimen of 220 mg/kg/day DB107-FC, which is to be self-administered.

candidate_flag.reason: The only non-gene-therapy agent is flucytosine (DB107-FC), an oral prodrug given to activate the gene therapy vector; whether it counts as a pharmacological candidate decides S6.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Histologically proven HGG that have recurred/progressed (first or second recurrence).

role_evidence.quote: DB107-Retroviral Replicating Vector (RRV) Combined With DB107-Flucytosine (FC)

agents.drug_class_hint: retroviral replicating vector gene therapy (DB107-RRV), given intratumourally and intravenously

role_evidence.quote: the investigational products, DB107-RRV and DB107-FC, as a combination treatment will shrink high-grade glioma (HGG)

agents.drug_class_hint: flucytosine (5-FC) extended-release tablets, antifungal prodrug used as the activating prodrug for the gene therapy

flag.reason: Flucytosine is only the activating prodrug of the gene therapy vector; candidate status depends on whether it is counted as a pharmacological antitumour agent.

source_quote.quote: Presence of Denovo Genomic Marker 7 (DGM7) biomarker in blood.

flag.reason: Study is called biomarker-guided but the record does not state whether DGM7 is mechanistically linked to DB107-RRV/DB107-FC.

coder_notes: DB107-RRV is gene therapy (excluded type). DB107-FC registered as Ancobon/Ancotil (flucytosine); coded experimental_combination as one of two investigational products named together. DGM7 link to the candidate is not described, so candidate_matched false; adjudicator may wish to check. Condition field lists high grade glioma and anaplastic astrocytoma only, GBM is named in the title and in inclusion criterion 3.
